name: MVP 28.0 – Cognitive Identity & Self Model
description: Adds a read-only identity and self-model layer so Pandora can clearly report what it is, what it can do, what it must not do, known weaknesses and safe operating boundaries.
features: Identity Card mit Mission, Systemtyp, Selbstbild und Nicht-Selbstbild
Capability Boundaries mit Stop-/Approval-Regeln und Truthfulness Rules
Self Model bündelt Identity, Capability Snapshot, kognitive Schnittstellen und Safe Operating Statement
Regressionstests für read-only Verhalten und Approval-Grenzen
